elements.name: tj-responsive
elements.description: Add responsiveness to the HTML elements below.

attributes.name: debug
attributes.description: Enable debug mode and output diagnostic information to the console.

attributes.name: layer
attributes.description: Optional CSS cascade layer for runtime-generated arbitrary utility rules.

attributes.name: style-xs
attributes.description: Responsive style for extra small screens (default).

attributes.name: style-sm
attributes.description: Responsive style from the small breakpoint.

attributes.name: style-md
attributes.description: Responsive style from the medium breakpoint.

attributes.name: style-lg
attributes.description: Responsive style from the large breakpoint.

attributes.name: style-xl
attributes.description: Responsive style from the extra large breakpoint.

attributes.name: style-xxl
attributes.description: Responsive style from the extra extra large breakpoint.
